blocks.text: Existential quantifier batata hai ke statement set ki kam az kam ek cheez ke liye sach hai (Figure 2.8 dekhein). Is ka nishaan “∃” hai (ulta E). Maslan “∃x, x is even” ka matlab hai “kam az kam ek x aisa maujood hai jo even (juft) hai.” Yeh quantifier tab istemal hota hai jab shart kuch cheezein poori karti hon, zaroori nahi ke sab. Is se imkanat aur khaas misalein bayan hoti hain. Problem solving aur reasoning ke liye existential quantifier aham hai.

blocks.alt: Do column. Universal Quantifier: ulte A ki alamat aur x wala box, teer neeche 'For all x, P(x)' tak. Existential Quantifier: ulte E ki alamat aur x wala box, teer neeche 'For some x, P(x)' tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.8: Universal aur existential quantifier (kitab ki Figure 2.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baayen ∀x ka matlab “For all x, P(x)”: P(x) har x ke liye sach. Daayen ∃x ka matlab “For some x, P(x)”: P(x) kam az kam ek x ke liye sach. Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: ∀ = ulta A (All), ∃ = ulta E (Exists).

items: ∃ (ulta E, Exists): statement kam az kam ek cheez ke liye sach.
Figure 2.8: ∀x → For all x, P(x); ∃x → For some x, P(x).
